issue_inputs.title: 0.3.0 important: make stdlib namespaces semantic and retire ad-hoc public APIs
0.4.0 important: structurally refactor stdlib after the 0.3.0 semantic freeze

criteria.requirement: Audit every current public item under `std::arithmetic`.
criteria.finding: All three former public definitions A001-A003 and their whole-space contracts/dispositions are enumerated.

criteria.requirement: Remove the ad-hoc fixed-instance public arithmetic routines, including `increment2`, `add2`, and `mul2_mod15`.
criteria.finding: The arithmetic module/registry entry and all three std exports are removed; retired-import regressions reject each name.

criteria.requirement: Preserve useful tiny circuits only as examples/tests/fixtures/corpus material where appropriate, not canonical stdlib APIs.
criteria.finding: The complete licensed arithmetic module survives byte-identically as local order-finding source; local tests and unchanged desired source pass.

criteria.requirement: Document the semantic admission rule for future `std::arithmetic` APIs.
criteria.finding: The admission rule requires reusable parameterized arithmetic/number theory independent of a hard-coded circuit.

criteria.requirement: Reserve `std::arithmetic` for scalable parameterized arithmetic / number-theoretic operations.
criteria.finding: Arithmetic is explicitly reserved; there is no current bundled arithmetic module or public export.

criteria.requirement: Record `std::arithmetic::modexp<N>` as a representative intended semantic API shape.
criteria.finding: modexp<N> is the representative modular-exponentiation design identity, explicitly not implemented syntax/availability.

criteria.requirement: Reserve `std::arithmetic::primefact<N>` as the v1 semantic factorization API identity.
criteria.finding: primefact<N> reserves the v1 factorization identity; algorithm names and delivered APIs are distinguished.

criteria.requirement: State normatively that algorithm names do not replace mathematical-operation names in canonical stdlib APIs.
criteria.finding: Normative names describe mathematical operations rather than implementation history, benchmarks, decompositions or algorithms.

criteria.requirement: State that explicit algorithm selection belongs in a parameter/policy/configuration layer.
criteria.finding: Explicit algorithm choice belongs in a parameter/policy/configuration layer; no new mechanism/grammar is claimed.

criteria.requirement: Rename `std::transforms` to `std::transform`.
criteria.finding: The registry and source expose std::transform; fixed qft2/qft3 preserve signatures, bodies, phase and axes.

criteria.requirement: Document the singular semantic-namespace convention for mathematical stdlib modules.
criteria.finding: The normative convention prefers singular semantic concept nouns independently of source layout.

criteria.requirement: Audit every current public member of `std::routines`.
criteria.finding: All five former public routines and the separate private nonzero2 helper are enumerated and classified.

criteria.requirement: Remove `std::routines` as a canonical public namespace.
criteria.finding: There is no routines registry entry or alias; regressions reject every former public import.

criteria.requirement: Rehome each former `std::routines` API under a namespace justified by its mathematical meaning, or make it non-public until such a classification exists.
criteria.finding: Hadamard moves to transform, phase-fixed reflection to reflection and complete instruments to measurement. nonzero2 stays private; the Hadamard import is not a re-export.

criteria.requirement: Do not replace `std::routines` with another semantically empty catch-all.
criteria.finding: The new homes have operator/projector/instrument meanings and adjacent-namespace exclusions; arbitrary observing routines are not measurement admission.

criteria.requirement: Give every public top-level mathematical namespace a documented semantic admission rule.
criteria.finding: Each of the four current ordinary mathematical modules and reserved arithmetic has an explicit admission rule. Compiler-owned quantum/observe/registers/classical catalogs retain their separate precise primitive contracts and sealed status; namespace placement confers no authority.

criteria.requirement: Update source/imports/examples/docs/corpus/fixtures/tests atomically for the namespace changes.
criteria.finding: One candidate changes the registry/four sources, 11 example imports, current docs, six corpus snapshots (12 source files), 19 fixture file selections and four complete native-client projects. Actual tests/scripts select recorded derivatives while preserving originals. The atomic integration commit is still pending.

criteria.requirement: Do not retain compatibility aliases for accidental pre-1.0 APIs without a demonstrated migration need.
criteria.finding: No retired namespace compatibility registration exists. Remaining active old strings are migration descriptions or negative assertions; reserved std protection is unchanged.

criteria.requirement: Keep all such stdlib functions ordinary checked `.qli` under #167.
criteria.finding: Nine public definitions and the private helper remain ordinary .qli. Bundled is distinct from sealed; common judgment checks every original declaration/body before concrete eligibility/native acceptance.

criteria.requirement: Align #152 so its 0.4.0 structural refactor consumes these 0.3.0 semantic namespace decisions without redefining them.
criteria.finding: The current #152 override/consumer boundary consumes actually completed #167/#317 contracts, preserves fixed-QFT meanings and prohibits restoring retired identities. Its separate 0.4.0 target and twelve structural criteria remain.

criteria.requirement: Document the general rule that parameterized mathematical families own the canonical API name; fixed-size names do not.
criteria.finding: The parameterized-family naming rule is normative without promising generic-family availability or correspondence. Generic QFT remains excluded from all v0.3.0/current-goal work.
